description:
Our team tests and builds platforms behind the fraud detection, data and machine-learning systems of Apple Pay, Wallet and other Apple services. That covers ML tooling and model evaluation, data validation, and On-Device Insight (ODI), the on-device risk signals behind fraud decisions. Our work makes sure models, signals and data are right before they reach customers, so Apple can stop fraud without adding friction or compromising privacy.

Description
We are growing the team to support a major new Apple Pay feature and the growth of our ML and data platforms. This role designs, builds and runs the iOS frameworks, data tools and self-service platform that engineering and data science teams use to build, check and ship on-device risk signals. Understand the problem and its users, design for growth, launch, and maintain.

Responsibilities
Building tools as products: problem definition, design, launch and maintenance
Developing iOS frameworks and apps for on-device risk signals
Creating new ways to generate realistic data on devices
Delivering a self-service platform: UX, UI, server and database

Minimum qualifications
3+ years of experience building products, tools or services that others rely on
Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
Proficiency in Swift and Python
Experience with ML evaluation and data analysis
Experience with SQL databases
Extensive experience using AI coding agents
Product mindset that starts with the problem and user needs
Scalable system design and architecture
Track record of building services, tools or platforms with real-world adoption
Ability to find solutions where no approach exists yet
Resilient, self-driven and quick to learn complex systems

Preferred qualifications
Experience shipping features in an iOS app or web service
Experience with XCTest and automation frameworks
Background in ML model evaluation
Data exploration and analysis skills
Experience generating synthetic data
